profile.constituencyprofile_Text:
Santhanuthalapadu Assembly Constituency, located in Prakasam District, covers four mandals—Chimakurthy, Santhanuthalapadu, N.G. Padu, and Maddipadu with a geographical area of about 956.4 sq. km. As per the 2011 Census, its population stood at 2.65 lakh, projected to reach 3.13 lakh in 2024, with Scheduled Castes forming a significant 31% and Scheduled Tribes about 3% of the total population. The constituency is known for its granite wealth, especially Chimakurthy’s Black Galaxy Granite, which has global recognition and provides direct and indirect employment to over 55,000 people. Agriculture remains the backbone of the economy, though farmers face challenges due to erratic rainfall, groundwater dependence, and inadequate irrigation support. Major crops include paddy, tobacco, cotton, chillies, and pulses, while the Gundlakamma Reservoir Project plays an important role in irrigation and drinking water supply.
The constituency has 78 revenue villages, 87 gram panchayats, 72 village secretariats, and 8 ward secretariats, reflecting a strong local governance network. Education is served by over 300 schools, 11 junior colleges, and higher education institutions including degree and engineering colleges, while healthcare support comes from 1 CHC, 8 PHCs, and 64 village-level health clinics. Despite this, issues such as water scarcity, unemployment, malnutrition, and migration remain pressing concerns. At the same time, the region holds opportunities for growth in granite-based industries, agro-processing, skill development, and eco-tourism, supported by cultural landmarks like the Tanguturi Prakasam Panthulu Museum, Gundlakamma Project, Ramateerdam, and historic temples.
profile.geography: Santhanuthalapadu constituency is located in Prakasam District and spans 956.4 sq. km., and the coastal length of the constituency is 8 km. It shares boundaries with the Markapuram, Darsi, and Kondepi constituencies. & the other side of the Bay of Bengal. Mix of fertile, partly upland, dependent on tanks, wells, and monsoon rains.
profile.populationDesc: The total population is 265,615, with approximately 87.12% residing in rural areas and 12.88% in urban areas. There are 68,692 households, and the sex ratio is 979 females per 1,000 males. The literacy rate stands at 63.29%.
profile.administrationDesc: Santhanuthalapadu Constituency is one of the eight assembly constituencies in Prakasam District. It includes 1) Chimakurthy, 2) Santhanuthalpadu, 3) N.G. Padu, and 4) Maddipadu Mandals. Santhanuthalapadu constituency comes under Bapatla Loksabha Constituency.
profile.educationHealthcareDesc: Santhanuthalapadu Constituency has 204 primary schools, 71 high schools, 11 junior colleges, and limited higher education facilities, reflecting moderate literacy but scope for improvement. Healthcare infrastructure includes 1 CHC, 8 PHCs, and 64 health clinics, though shortages of specialists and resources remain a major concern.

economy_text.economy_Text:
Economy at a Glance

Santhanuthalapadu's economy is a well-diversified mix of industry, agriculture, and services, with significant growth potential across all three sectors. The Gross Constituency Domestic Product (GCDP) is estimated at ₹7,302 crore in 2023–24 and is projected to reach ₹15,417 crore by 2028–29, growing at a CAGR of 16.12%.

The industrial sector, currently contributing ₹2,963 crore, is a major pillar of the local economy. It is anchored by the globally renowned granite industry in Chimakurthy, famous for its premium Galaxy Granite exports. This positions the region as a strategic hub for attracting granite processing industries, including cutting, polishing, fabrication, and export logistics. With the right investments, Santhanuthalapadu could emerge as a granite-based industrial cluster, generating large-scale employment and value addition.

The agriculture and allied sector, valued at ₹1,966 crore, remains vital to rural livelihoods. The region is a major producer of Bengal gram (10,158 ha) and tobacco (8,802 ha). Modernizing farming practices, expanding irrigation, and encouraging agri-processing will enhance productivity and income security.

The service sector, currently contributing ₹1,826 crore, is steadily expanding with growth in education, retail, healthcare, and transport services, supported by improving connectivity and infrastructure.

With strong natural resources, industrial potential, and a growing service ecosystem, Santhanuthalapadu is poised for balanced and inclusive economic growth over the coming decade.
economy_text.gcdP_Growth_Text: Santhanuthalapadu is witnessing strong economic momentum with a targeted 14-16% annual GCDP growth rate, driven by agro-based industries, granite processing, tobacco trade, and rural services. With its rich natural resources and industrial potential, the constituency is on track to become a leading rural-industrial hub in Andhra Pradesh by 2047.
